effects.text: Select one Curse, Charm, Compulsion, possession or controlling/transforming effect on the target and attempt to Counteract it; +2 circumstance if your Judged Subject created it (enter it in the Counteract dialog's circumstance box).

warps.text: You may attempt to Counteract two eligible effects affecting the same creature. Make separate checks

system.description:
GRIMWARD SOUL UTILITY WARDING
Grimward Specialist Spell
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Range 30 feet
Targets 1 creature

You attempt to cut away a supernatural influence acting upon the target.
Select one Curse, Charm, Compulsion, possession effect or magical effect that directly controls or forcibly transforms the target. Attempt to Counteract the selected effect.
If the effect was created by your current Judged Subject, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to the Counteract check.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: You may attempt to Counteract two eligible effects affecting the same creature. Make separate checks.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
